dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this stone tablet is talking about events from the past...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It's lighting up! And those symbols over there are lighting up too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we activate all those symbols, maybe that huge door might open!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Who knows what might be inside... Let's see if there are any more tablets like this one, {NICKNAME}!
